messages:
emma: heads-up — after the RBAC change this morning i see a spike of cert issuance failures for sni-proxy in apac (pods failing TLS handshake). logs: `cert-rotator: failed to unwrap key: permission denied`

raj: can you paste the exact rotator error and which SA/role was changed?

emma: error from cert-rotator (snippet):
```
cert-rotator ERROR: UnwrapKey failed: googleapi: Error 403: Permission denied to decrypt, service account "svc-cert-rotator@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" lacks roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```

li: that looks like kms:Decrypt lost. we rolled a tight RBAC change to remove broad KMS roles earlier for ENG-PLATFORM - likely removed cryptoKeyDecrypter binding from that SA.

taylor: apac proxies fallback to non-canonical certs until rotator succeeds? we're seeing ocsp failures and TLS 526 from edge. impact: degraded traffic routing for a subset of customers.

sec-bot: (audit) role_binding_update detected: user raj changed binding on project:redwood-prod at 1732449000 — removed role roles/cloudkms.admin from member svc-cert-rotator@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com

raj: yep that was my change to reduce blast radius. i've got the PR link: https://git.company/infra/rbac/PR-142. i didn't realize rotator needed cryptoKeyDecrypter specifically; assumed decrypt still allowed via key-specific bindings. my bad.

emma: quick mitigation proposal: re-add roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on the key resource to the rotator SA (least privilege) and restart cert-rotator in apac. steps i ran locally: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding my-key --member=serviceAccount:svc-cert-rotator@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/cert-rotator -n infra-apac`

li: also we discovered audit logs for KMS key access weren't forwarded to splunk for apac — audit filter dropped key access events. we need to enable audit log type DATA_ACCESS for the KMS resource in that org policy. without that we can't prove scope of exposure.

taylor: vulnerability angle: i'm triaging whether this is an auth misconfig only or if there's a broader key-exposure problem. so far no external reads, just denied decrypts. no CVE involved, seems config-only.

raj: rolling back my PR now to restore the binding. will apply minimal role on the key instead of project-level admin.

emma: after the binding re-add i restarted rotator and one issuance succeeded for canary SNI host. i'm watching traffic.

sec-bot: (audit) policy_update detected: org policy changed to include DATA_ACCESS for resource //cloudkms.googleapis.com/projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/prod-keys/cryptoKeys/my-key at 1732459800

li: action items i captured: 1) create a key-scoped RBAC recipe in docs (least privilege for rotator) 2) enable and validate DATA_ACCESS audit forwarding for apac 3) add an automated canary test that exercises cert issuance after RBAC changes 4) postmortem if impact > 30m

taylor: also we should update the RBAC change playbook to `check-rotator-deps.sh` before merging. snippet to add to CI: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy my-key | grep svc-cert-rotator` and `kubectl -n infra-REGION rollout status deploy/cert-rotator`

emma: noted. i'll open a follow-up with the runbook + remediation commands and tag infra and platform. link: https://runbooks.company/incidents/sni-issuance-rbac-triage (prep draft) :memo:

raj: sorry for the breakage, learned lesson. will ping security next time i remove KMS bindings. :bow:
